meta.name: landing-experience-checker
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "pre-launch check the landing page", "run a Quality-Score preflight", or "verify ad-to-page message match before launch"; produces an ad↔page continuity report — message-match gaps, above-the-fold check, page-speed read, form-friction count, mobile-render flags — as a pass/fix punch list. Not for redesigning or rewriting the page — use landing-optimizer; not for scoring the account or the RQS — use ad-account-auditor. 落地页体验预检/广告落地页一致性检查

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查落地页与广告信息是否一致，生成优化清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在广告上线前检查落地页体验与信息匹配度
copy.tagline_en: Check landing page against ad message and generate a fix list
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify ad-to-page consistency before launch

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查落地页与广告的一致性，生成一份包含消息匹配、首屏内容、页面速度、表单摩擦和移动端渲染五项检查的通过/修复清单。
howto.when: 当你要求“预检落地页”、“运行质量评分预检”或“验证广告与页面消息匹配”时触发。

say.text: 预检这个落地页：https://example.com，广告文案是“限时五折”。
say.note: Claude 会检查页面是否兑现了五折承诺。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude checks the landing page against the ads and produces a pass/fix punch list covering message-match, above-the-fold content, page speed, form friction, and mobile rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "pre-launch check the landing page", "run a Quality-Score preflight", or "verify ad-to-page message match before launch".

say_en.text: Preflight this landing page: https://example.com, ad copy is "50% off limited time".
say_en.note: Claude checks if the page delivers the 50% off promise.

say_en.text: Run a Quality-Score preflight on https://example.com: above-the-fold, speed, form, mobile.
say_en.note: Claude runs all five checks and marks each as pass/partial/fix.
